comparison.score_definition: maximum over all retained curves/points of absolute displacement from center divided by the lower or upper readout half-width on that side; <=1 means every point is inside its envelope
comparison.zero_half_width_policy: exact equality has zero departure; any displacement toward a zero half-width is unbounded and serialized as null with an explicit flag

calibration.definition: C_abs multiplies nominal-to-scenario-corrected radiance observations, never the forward population or detector responsivity
calibration.provenance: Exploratory .01-100 nominal-to-corrected radiance multipliers; no calibration uncertainty claim.
calibration.interpretation: exploratory sensitivity scenarios; not a confidence interval or probability distribution

registered_observation.time_registration: manufactured signed photon clock, breakdown t=0
registered_observation.provenance: Numerical recoverability fixture, not physical spectra.

comparison.thermal_coordinate_definition: Manufactured source translational parameter; rotational/vibrational descriptors are not used as gas temperature.

limits: Readout envelopes are reconstruction support, not stochastic errors; point counts do not increase statistical weight.
All minima and compatible values refer only to supplied complete cases and scanned scales; unsampled alternatives remain unresolved.
Matching contract labels and owner attestations are admission requirements, not independent validation of kinetics, transport, conservation, opacity or convergence.
Source inventory is the single fitted amplitude coordinate; no independent density or monolayer amplitude is fitted.
Neutral columns/densities and the declared thermal coordinate are supplied forward diagnostics; internal populations do not automatically define translational gas temperature.
A categorical reconstruction assumption or exploratory calibration scale does not establish a verified absolute calibration or physical estimate.

manufactured_truth_not_used_by_compariso.purpose: Independent validation label only; never used by comparison.
